Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain mailers from use tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the taxation of direct mail; adding a newsection to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter do not apply with respect to the useof mail consisting solely of unbound sheets of paper, the primarypurpose of which is to promote the sale of products or services formultiple businesses that are unrelated to the person creating themailer, which is printed outside the state for the person and maileddirectly to Washington residents.
